name: bharosa
description: Bharosa (भरोसा): Blockchain-Based Secure Platform for Identity, Access Control & Digital Asset Management - SIH 2026
author: Team LUMINARYFORGE

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @bharosa/contracts node & pnpm --filter @bharosa/api dev & pnpm --filter @bharosa/web dev
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @bharosa/contracts test && pnpm --filter @bharosa/sdk test && pnpm --filter @bharosa/api test
scripts.security:check: pnpm audit --audit-level high && pnpm --filter @bharosa/contracts security:check && pnpm test
